name: studyspace
description: Local-first PDF study workspace: your course PDFs, page-aware notes, highlights and page tools, fully offline

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
